quote: The Fight introduced me to true masculinity, a brotherhood of men, and true intimacy with God because I could trust Him.
author: John Sharp

quote: The Fight helped me understand who I really am... a son of the King of kings.
author: Brian Bradley

quote: After The Fight, I finally understood the masculinity of Jesus. As a man of God, I am charged to lead courageously, expect God's blessings, accept responsibility, and reject passivity.
author: David Sparks

quote: The knowledge and understanding I gained from The Fight made me a better manager, husband, and father.
author: Jason "Bru" Bourgoyne

quote: The Fight revealed to me that my testimony was not just about the day I got saved, but my entire life's journey - and it is God's to use like a tool belt full of tools to reach other men through the unique experiences He gave me.
author: Brent Knox

quote: In The Fight, we are as a herd protecting one another through Christ.
author: Mike Bailey

quote: The Fight taught me that I am not the only one.
author: Robby Martin

quote: The Fight for Manhood - yes! But praise Jesus Christ: I fight as a victorious son of the King, and I don't fight alone!
author: Mark Beeler

quote: I was a grown man by the world's standards. After The Fight, I realized I am a real man by God's standard.
author: Greg Horton

quote: The Fight gave me the playbook I was always looking for - how to be the husband, father, and man I wanted to be.
author: Greg Horton

quote: Dealing with Law and Grace finally helped me understand the New Creation Scripture promises.
author: Robby Martin

quote: The Fight answered the 'Why I keep doing...' questions by giving me understanding. I found a brotherhood of godly men that I didn't know I needed!
author: Jason "Bru" Bourgoyne

quote: Boys look in the mirror and pretend. A man looks in the mirror and faces what he sees.
author: Greg Horton

quote: A transformational perspective of our ideal role model as a man, Jesus Christ. This continues to change my life.
author: Dick Hash

quote: Understanding the difference between guilt - a truth about a wrong - and shame - a lie about who I am - was a life changer for me.
author: Robby Martin

quote: In a world where real manhood is constantly being challenged, Fight for Manhood has given me and my fellow graduates sound, biblically based guidance on what it means to live as men of character, live with purpose, and leave a lasting legacy.
author: Tom Franklin

quote: Since becoming a believer in Christ, this was the first time I felt heard and understood, as well as gained an understanding of who Jesus is and who I am as a man because of Him.
author: Jody Griffin
